card.text: WASP-189 b crosses WASP-189 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-189 b"
sources.quote: WASP-189 b is an ultra-hot jupiter that orbits around the A-type star WASP-189 which is located about 322 light years from Earth in the Libra constellation.

introduction.text: It turns once in 1.2 days, which flattens it by 2.88%, and its planet's orbit passes over its poles.

sources.label: Deline et al. (2022), Astronomy & Astrophysics 659 A74
Wikipedia, "WASP-189 b"
sources.quote: It was first discovered in 2018, and was observed in 2020 by CHEOPS.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: Gaia's color of the star, brighter and bluer at the poles where its fast spin makes it hotter. The darker edge is a model.
